tagline: Commission monitoring installations with fresh signed tests and paid inspection.
problem: Operators accepting subcontracted monitoring installations need evidence that equipment is placed correctly, responds to physical tests, and meets the declared software policy.
solution: An operator approves an immutable work order. A technician captures marker-guided placement and signed button/LED tests. A deterministic inspector explains defects. A policy contract verifies signed NVD data before an evidence-bound acceptance decision.
currentImplementation: The station and signed protocols run locally. A useful paid Sokosumi REVIEW on Cardano Preprod reached confirmed withdrawal and positive seller collection. Its original input was synthetic and lacked optical evidence. Two genuine paid NVD requests settled. Five source checks passed against the deployed Base Sepolia policy. The valid transaction changed OPEN to REJECTED because the paid REVIEW did not pass inspection. Physical commissioning and the complete demo video remain incomplete. The reviewed optical-only ESP32-C6 image is flashed and USB startup/public-key verification passed. A real signed 18-second diagnostic response verified. Offline Seeker recording analysis matched all 72 symbols. Phone Chrome now saves a real camera measurement through the station using explicit rear-lens selection. These separate results do not establish a complete tracked optical commissioning capture. No button transition ran. Judge-supplied response testing is available. Complete API3 qualification remains unconfirmed because the existing false inspection predicate forces rejection regardless of the CVE verdict. The separate physical station now supports an explicitly disabled contact profile. A real Seeker camera inspection returned REWORK for incorrect placement. Its original negative packet verified against the work-order digest saved before capture. No device receipt or optical emission occurred in that attempt.
howItWorks: Approve a fixed work-order template and start a fresh attempt.
Capture signed contact transitions and camera-observed optical evidence.
Inspect immutable evidence through a useful paid service.
Verify the original source signature, request, timing and enrolled software policy on chain.
Reconcile original receipts and contract commitments before READY. Missing evidence returns REVIEW.
whySignedDataMatters: A forged or substituted vulnerability response can misstate software acceptance. The contract checks the configured Airnode, exact CVE request and source age. NVD signatures do not identify firmware installed on a physical device.
businessCase: Hypothesis: an integrator accepting remote monitoring installations pays for a reproducible specialist report and fewer ambiguous handovers. Customer demand, pricing and reduced revisits remain unvalidated.
challenges: BLE fragmentation and original receipt binding
Fresh capture versus later report/escrow validity
Durable claims before uncertain external operations
Exact signed bytes and independent payment/source reconciliation
dataWantedButUnavailable: An authenticated manufacturer build/provenance record tied to this physical board. The current enrolled build remains an operator declaration.
